title: A2R agent output (a2r-render-reviewer)
description: A judgement on ONE rendered page against the book page it reproduces. Item = one page of one chapter's export. This step exists because every other check in this project looks at the INPUT: A2 judges what the page says, A2S what a figure contains, A2L how it is laid out. Nothing judged the OUTPUT, so defects that were obvious to a person looking at the page -- a structure cropped in half, a worked example printed twice, a heading broken mid-word, half a page blank where content should be -- were shipped by builds that reported success, and were found only when the owner read the PDF. The scripted checks catch what can be stated as a rule; this catches what has to be seen.

verdict.description: `content_missing` whenever anything printed in the book is absent from the render -- that outranks any number of cosmetic differences, because a reader cannot recover what is not there. `unusable` for a page that is garbled, duplicated or out of order.

findings.description: One entry per difference, most serious first. An empty list is only valid with verdict `matches`.

kind.description: `clipped` = present but cut off at an edge. `misplaced` = present but in the wrong column, order or panel. `formatting` = present and correct but set wrongly (lost italics, lost colour, wrong face).

what.description: What the BOOK shows and what the render shows instead, concretely enough to find: name the figure, equation or heading. 'Fig 9.2's right-hand molecule is cut off at the frame edge', not 'a figure is wrong'.

where.description: Where on the page, in plain words: 'top left', 'the worked example box', 'under Table 9.1'.

note.description: Required. What you compared and anything that limited the comparison -- a region too small to judge, a colour difference that may be rendering rather than content.
